reviews.text:
Celeste was simply brilliant!
She did her job on a far from easy occasion: our wedding, with all the emotion, excitement, and organization that such an important day entails. Despite this, she was always sweet, attentive, patient, and professional with our baby.
She gave us tremendous peace of mind, allowing us to enjoy our special day knowing our little one was in excellent hands. We are truly happy we chose her and would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable and caring babysitter.
Thank you so much, Celeste!

I had an extremely positive experience with this agency. The manager immediately proved to be highly competent, helpful, and focused on finding concrete solutions.

Even when difficulties arose, she didn't just provide an answer, but quickly identified practical and effective solutions, handling every situation with great professionalism. I particularly appreciated her prompt response, her consistently clear and transparent communication, her ability to coordinate every aspect of the service, and her constant focus on simplifying management, avoiding unnecessary complications.

I am very satisfied with the service I received and recommend this agency to anyone looking for professionalism, reliability, and genuine support.

We spent a week in Sardinia with our one-year-old baby and entrusted ourselves to Compagnia delle Fate. It was a truly wonderful experience! The babysitter was so sweet, loving, always punctual, and very professional. Our baby had a wonderful time, and we were able to relax knowing he was in good hands. We wholeheartedly recommend this service!
Impeccable service. Professional and extremely precise. I was truly satisfied! Thank you so much, Fatina Valeria ♥️

Thanks to Monica and Anna for making our summer joyful and relaxing. Anna was the perfect match for our family during our Italian vacation. The service provided by the fairy agency is top-notch. I highly recommend it!

A lifesaver! A very professional company that helped us several times in completely different geographical locations to find someone capable of caring for our children, who only spoke English and Russian at the time! Between Naples, Courmayeur, Forte dei Marmi, and Milan, they always helped us, including travel expenses!

Professionalism, courtesy, and availability. The service is tailor-made, with trained, high-quality staff: with them, we feel assured that our little one will spend quality time, not with a "supervisor," but with proactive, high-quality people. Highly recommended.

Very useful service for having access to reliable nannies quickly in Louis where you don't usually find Rosie or for spot needs. Our nanny, Monique, was fantastic. She gave us a sense of trust from the first mention and was impeccable with our daughter.

Two months ago I left my first positive review about the 3-fairy trial... then TIZIANA arrived... and believe me, words are superfluous... Tiziana was a godsend for us! An angel... someone who HELPED US IN EVERYTHING from the very beginning! 100% integrated into our family, loved by everyone, grandparents, cousins, aunts and uncles... Tiziana is an exceptional person, one of those rare ones that when life decides to give you the gift of meeting her, you will be forever grateful! I couldn't say if Tiziana taught my son more or me. By observing her, I learned so many things, I saw love and passion. She truly cared for my child as if he were her own. She knows everything for me, a person truly with a thousand knowledge about all aspects of life. Tiziana gave me serenity and security! Thanks to her, my two-and-a-half-year-old son has calmed down; she even taught him to take off his diapers, to be patient, to be polite in certain situations, and to walk "with his little hand" without a stroller. I could write pages and pages, but they wouldn't be enough for someone as impeccable as Tiziana. Thank you, Compagnia delle Fate, for the immense gift you've given us!
